test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Change the voice of the following sentence.

The fort has been guarded by moats and well-trained soldiers.

options.text: Moats and well-trained soldiers has guarded the fort.
Moats and well-trained soldiers have guarded the fort
Moats and well-trained soldiers have guarded by the fort.
Moats and well-trained soldiers have been guarding the fort.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Moats and well-trained soldiers have guarded the fort."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the fort" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have guarded" to "has been guarded" (present perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "moats and well-trained soldiers."
 
• Ensure the sentence maintains clarity and grammatical correctness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Moats and well-trained soldiers have guarded the fort​**.*"

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Moats and well-trained soldiers has guarded the fort." – Incorrect subject-verb agreement.
 
• **Option 3: **"Moats and well-trained soldiers have guarded by the fort." – Incorrect sentence structure.
 
• **Option 4: **"Moats and well-trained soldiers have been guarding the fort." – Incorrect tense (present perfect continuous).
